thread:
alix: Quick heads-up — MerchantCo kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Goal: align POC acceptance criteria, prompt set, and security ask list before the call. Can folks add what they need by EOD?

marta: On POC criteria — need 3 canonical success scenarios (core flow, edge-case, and hallucination-resilience). Also want throughput targets: 300 reqs/min sustained, p50 < 250ms.

samir: For prompts I suggest a small golden set (30 examples) + 3 adversarial variants each. We should capture expected output and failure mode notes.

priya: Security side: MerchantCo sent an initial questionnaire. Key asks: data residency, KMS integration, and audit log retention. I've started answers but need infra confirmation on KMS.

carl-sales: Pricing question from them — if they exceed trial capacity, what's the immediate uplift path? Need a short doc to share (dedicated vs burst).

alix: Good callouts. I'll draft the acceptance rubric. Proposed fields: scenario id, input prompt, expected tokens, pass/fail rules, manual review threshold, regression weight.

marta: We also need a scoring function for the harness. Proposed: composite score = 0.6*exactness + 0.3*factuality + 0.1*style. Each example gets a 0-1. Gate = mean >= 0.8 and no critical regressions.

samir: Snippet for golden entry format I used before:
```
- id: G001
  prompt: "Summarize customer complaint and propose next step"
  expected: "Two-sentence summary + 1 suggested action"
  score_weights: {exactness: 0.6, factuality: 0.3, tone: 0.1}
```

priya: For the security questionnaire, can someone confirm: do we offer per-tenant KMS or customer-managed keys in private? I recall private deployment yes, hosted needs KMS integration via HSM? @carl-sales fyi.

carl-sales: I'll escalate the KMS ask with Solutions. Also they asked about SOC2 and FedRAMP readiness — we can share SOC2 report but FedRAMP is not in scope for this pilot.

alix: Timeline proposal: today — finalize rubric + goldens; tomorrow — run baseline against model variants; day 3 — present pilot report in review. Does that work?

marta: Works for me. I'll assemble the golden set and label passes/expected outputs by EOD.

samir: I'll run an initial pass on the large unquantized model and a q4_8 variant; will capture latency and token counts.

priya: Security-bot: auto-check on questionnaire attachment?

security-bot: Received questionnaire.pdf — scanning for PII, checksums, and flagged fields. Found request for long-term audit logs and encryption-at-rest confirmation.

priya: Perfect. For audit logs retention, we can confirm 1 year by default for Hosted; Dedicated can increase retention via console. Need PM/infra to confirm limits.

carl-sales: Meanwhile, merchant asked about acceptance gates for hallucination. How strict should we be on partial answers?

marta: If critical facts are missing or contradicted, fail. If minor omissions — score penalized but may pass if overall composite >= gate. Add manual review for borderline cases.

alix: Action list: 1) Marta: golden set + expected outputs, 2) Samir: baseline runs (latency + token usage), 3) Priya: finish security Qs + KMS confirmation, 4) Carl: prepare pricing uplift doc and escalate KMS. I'll circulate the acceptance rubric before 6pm.

carl-sales: One more: can we include an example pricing line for a 3-week burst to dedicated (+ SLA) so they can budget quickly?

samir: Quick config snippet for eval run in case helpful:
```yaml
eval: merchant_trial_v1
models: [redwood-7b, redwood-7b-q4_8]
batching: {max_tokens: 512, max_batch_size: 16}
metrics: [latency_p50, throughput, composite_score]
```

alix: Awesome. If no objections I’ll close the prep thread at 5:30 and push materials to the drive. Please ping me for anything late. :thumbsup: 

priya: No objections. Also adding a note to legal about the pilot terms (data usage).

marta: Uploaded goldens -> https://drive.company/merchant-goldens (placeholder link).

carl-sales: Thanks team. See you on the call.
